clips.title: The story
paras: Thotar is a seasoned orc hunter trainer stationed in the settlement of Razor Hill in Durotar. He guides aspiring Horde scouts and marksmen in the ancient traditions of tracking, archery, and bonding with wild beasts. For young orcs and trolls taking their first steps outside the Valley of Trials, he provides the foundational rites needed to master Kalimdor's rugged fauna.

Perched within the fortified hub of Razor Hill, Thotar serves as a veteran instructor for marksmen of the Horde. While new recruits learn the very basics in the Valley of Trials, it falls to Thotar to guide hunters as they face the harsher predatory wilderness of Durotar. Drawing upon traditions passed down through countless generations of orcs, he teaches not only marksmanship, but the deeper respect required to live alongside and direct Kalimdor's deadliest creatures.

Thotar plays a crucial role in introducing young hunters to the ancient art of beast taming. Through a sequence of trials, he sends novices into the arid canyons to pacify and commune with native beasts, such as venomous scorpid, armored surf crawlers, and cunning boars. By guiding these young scouts through the sacred rites of taming, Thotar ensures the Horde's trackers build a loyal bond with nature rather than merely attempting to dominate it by force.
